title: (Junior) DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor
description: **Junior DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor** **Location:** This is a full-time, permanent and office-based position in Dublin. You must be comfortable working on-site daily. **Salary:** €30,000–€38,000 We are recruiting a DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor to join the workplace health and wellbeing team of a major international organisation in Dublin. This is a permanent, full-time position supporting employees with Display Screen Equipment assessments, workplace ergonomics, reasonable adjustments and wider healthy-working requirements. The role suits someone with hands-on DSE assessment experience in a corporate environment who enjoys working directly with employees to resolve workplace comfort, ergonomic, and accessibility issues. You will work with employees who may require additional support due to musculoskeletal concerns, pregnancy, neurodiversity, disability or other health-related requirements, helping identify appropriate workplace adjustments and practical solutions. **What you’ll be doing:** **You will:** * Conduct individual DSE and Healthy Working Assessments * Carry out assessments for high-risk employees and new and expectant mothers * Support employees requiring workplace enablement or reasonable adjustments * Review workstation setups and identify ergonomic risks or areas for improvement * Recommend appropriate ergonomic equipment, furniture and workplace adjustments * Conduct both face-to-face and video-based assessments * Produce clear, accurate assessment reports and document recommendations * Manage follow-up assessments and individual cases through to resolution * Work with HR, Health & Safety, Office Operations and Technology teams where required * Support employees with more complex health, accessibility or neurodiverse requirements * Assist with the organisation's on-site Accessibility Centre * Deliver employee drop-in sessions and guide healthy working practices * Liaise with specialist external providers where additional support is required * Support employees at Dublin offices and occasionally at other Dublin client locations **What we’re looking for:** Ideally, you will have at least one year of practical experience carrying out DSE or Healthy Working Assessments. **You should have:** * Experience conducting DSE/workstation assessments * A good understanding of workplace ergonomics * Knowledge of ergonomic equipment and furniture * An understanding of workplace Health & Safety requirements * Confidence dealing directly with employees, including individuals with more complex health or accessibility needs * Strong written communication and report-writing skills * Good organisational and case-management skills * Confidence working independently and managing your own appointment schedule * Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Teams and related workplace systems Experience using DSE assessment platforms such as Cardinus would be advantageous. Candidates from Physiotherapy, Occupational Health, Occupational Therapy, Ergonomics or similar backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate relevant workplace assessment experience. **Right to Work:** Applicants must already hold the unrestricted right to work in Ireland. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. **Start Date:** The organisation is looking to appoint as soon as possible, so candidates available at short notice are particularly welcome. If you have experience supporting employees with workplace ergonomics, DSE assessments and healthy-working solutions and would like to join a large international organisation, we would be interested in hearing from you. Contact: Elvis Eckardt

Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?** **Work-life balance** At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership. **#WeAreWSP** *Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. title: Actuarial Analyst I
description: Title: Actuarial Analyst I Company: Everest International Insurance Job Category: Analytics Job Description: Everest is a leading global reinsurance and insurance organization with extensive product and distribution capabilities, a strong balance sheet, and an innovative culture. Throughout its history, Everest has maintained a disciplined focus on creating long-term value through underwriting excellence and strong risk and capital management. At Everest, the future is shaped by the actions taken today. These actions extend beyond business strategy and encompass the values that are important to employees and the communities in which the company operates. Everest's commitments include providing an inclusive work environment that supports professional development, investing in communities through the donation of time and financial resources, maintaining integrity across all aspects of the organization, and driving innovation to help solve complex global risks. Why Join? Everest Insurance International Wholesale & Specialty (IW&S) is part of a global organization. IW&S consists of Everest Syndicate 2786, Everest Insurance Ireland DAC (EIID), and Everest Insurance Singapore (EIS). This is an exciting time to join IW&S as the business continues to develop and grow its wholesale and specialty portfolio, investing in talent, systems, and capabilities under a global strategy. The Actuarial Function plays a key role in supporting and influencing the business's strategic objectives and long-term ambitions. Significant investment and collaboration across the wider Group are helping establish a best-in-class actuarial function. The structure of IW&S provides the opportunity to make a tangible impact on both the day-to-day operations and the future direction of the actuarial department. The successful candidate will play an important role in shaping strategy, enhancing actuarial capabilities, and strengthening business partnerships across the organization. Role Purpose As a key member of the actuarial function, the successful candidate will support and help drive both business-as-usual activities and strategic initiatives, working collaboratively with colleagues across the actuarial team and wider business. In addition to contributing to the ongoing development of the team's capabilities, the successful candidate will take ownership of key aspects of actuarial processes, stakeholder management, business reporting, and capital management activities. The role will also involve supporting actuarial leadership through analysis that informs key business decisions and company results. This is a broad and varied role offering exposure to a wide network of stakeholders, multiple actuarial disciplines, project initiatives, and quarterly reporting activities. The successful candidate will enjoy a high degree of autonomy within a supportive and collaborative environment. This opportunity is well suited to someone seeking a steep learning curve, ownership of meaningful work, and the ability to make a visible impact on the business. Key Accountabilities * Support the development and calibration of key actuarial assumptions and methodologies. * Assist in the reporting of actuarial results to key stakeholders, Group functions, and regulatory bodies. * Contribute to pricing, reserving, and capital management discussions with underwriting, actuarial, claims, finance, and reinsurance teams to support underwriting performance and business outcomes. * Deliver actuarial analysis that supports the business planning process and communicate findings to internal and external stakeholders. * Collaborate with actuaries, claims professionals, and underwriters to share information, influence decision-making, and gain alignment on actuarial assumptions. * Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements. * Develop tools, reporting capabilities, and analytical outputs that leverage actuarial data to improve underwriting performance and provide meaningful insights to senior management and key stakeholders. * Support the timely delivery and effective communication of actuarial results and recommendations. Professional Experience * Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree or higher in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. **Skills & Abilities** * Strong technical skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SQL, Power BI, and AI-enabled tools. * Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. * Ability to communicate complex modelling processes and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences through presentations, reports, and discussions. * Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. * Flexible, enthusiastic, and proactive approach, with a genuine desire to learn and develop professionally. Competencies * Embrace and demonstrate Everest's Core Values: Collaboration, Thoughtful Assumption of Risk, Execution, Humility, and Leadership. * Uphold Everest's Core Values in all interactions with colleagues, customers, and business partners. * Contribute to a culture of integrity, accountability, and excellence through day-to-day responsibilities and decision-making. Everest's success, and the success of its employees, begins with these values. All employees are expected to support and embody these principles in their interactions with others and throughout their daily work. *What if I don’t meet every requirement? At Everest we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. So, if you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every element in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Please let us know if you need any accommodations throughout the application or interview process.* **Our Culture** At Everest, our purpose is to provide the world with protection. We help clients and businesses thrive, fuel global economies, and create sustainable value for our colleagues, shareholders and the communities that we serve. We also pride ourselves on having a unique and inclusive culture which is driven by a unified set of values and behaviors. Click here to learn more about our culture. * Our Values are the guiding principles that inform our decisions, actions and behaviors. They are an expression of our culture and an integral part of how we work: Talent. Thoughtful assumption of risk. Execution. Efficiency. Humility. Leadership. Collaboration. Inclusion and Belonging. * Our Colleague Behaviors define how we operate and interact with each other no matter our location, level or function: Respect everyone. Pursue better. Lead by example. Own our outcomes. Win together. All colleagues are held accountable to upholding and supporting our values and behaviors across the company. This includes day to day interactions with fellow colleagues, and the global communities we serve. Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Primary Location: Dublin, Ireland Additional Locations: Privacy Notice | Everest (everestglobal.com)

title: Actuarial Consultant
description: Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.** **About The Role** As an **Actuarial Consultant** , you'll join the Optum Advisory team, supporting the development of next-generation pricing and analytical solutions for the U.S. health insurance market using cutting edge data science models and tools. This is a unique opportunity for a developing actuary with a passion for data science and emerging technologies. You'll work at the intersection of actuarial modelling, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data engineering, helping to design and deploy innovative solutions that influence pricing strategy and business performance. Working alongside experienced actuaries, data scientists, and technology professionals, you'll gain exposure to large-scale healthcare datasets, advanced analytical techniques, and modern cloud-based data platforms, all while progressing toward actuarial qualification through Optum's comprehensive study support programme. Our actuarial development programme includes paid study leave, reimbursement for study materials and exams, and salary increases tied to exam success, ensuring you have the support and resources needed to accelerate your career. As part of a global organization with access to vast data assets, innovative technologies, and diverse lines of business, you'll have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges, develop highly sought-after technical skills, and make a meaningful impact in healthcare through data and analytics. Careers with Optum offer flexible work arrangements and individuals who live and work in the Republic of Ireland will have the opportunity to split their monthly work hours between our Dublin or Letterkenny office and telecommuting from a home-based office in a hybrid work model. **Primary Responsibilities** * Leverage AI tools in all aspects of your work to deliver value * Apply actuarial and statistical techniques to analyse healthcare and insurance data * Develop, validate, and maintain datasets that support pricing and predictive modelling initiatives * Build and enhance actuarial models through the application of machine learning and AI methodologies * Perform data validation, quality assurance, and reconciliation activities to ensure data integrity * Support the design, testing, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of pricing and forecasting solutions * Collaborate with actuarial, data science, product, and engineering teams to deliver analytical solutions * Contribute to the development of innovative products and tools used within the U.S. health insurance market * Continue progressing toward actuarial qualification through Optum's actuarial development programme You will be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, as well as providing development for other roles you may be interested in. **Required Qualifications** * Partially qualified actuary with proven experience in actuarial, insurance, analytics, or related quantitative disciplines * Demonstrated interest in data science, predictive modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence * Demonstrated programming experience and aptitude for working with large datasets * Demonstrated solid analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills * Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary teams * Demonstrated curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies **Preferred Qualifications** * Proven experience utilizing R, Python, SQL, or similar programming languages * Demonstrated exposure to machine learning, predictive modeling, or artificial intelligence applications * Proven experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks and Microsoft Azure * Demonstrated familiarity with GitHub or other version control tools * Proven experience supporting pricing, forecasting, insurance analytics, or insurance product analysis * Proven experience within healthcare or health insurance environments **Please note you must currently be eligible to work and remain indefinitely without any restrictions in the country to which you are making an application. Proof will be required to support your application.** *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.* *Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: Optum is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, disability, religion, age, race, and membership of the Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: CNS, Renal Patient Care Coordinator
description: Overview: **Post Title:** CNM2 Renal Patient Care Coordinator Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS) **Post Status:** Full time Permanent **Department:** TUN Directorate **Location:** Beaumont Hospital, Dublin 9 **Reports to:** Directorate Nurse Manager/CNM3 **Salary:** Appointment will be made on the Clinical Nurse Specialist grade at a point in line with Government pay policy (€62,699 - €79,227 LSI) **Hours of work:** Full-Time 37.5 hours per week. **Closing Date: 13/11/2026 at 12:00 - Please note the hospital reserves the right to close the competition early should a substantial number of applications be received.** **Position Summary:** The Renal Patient Care Co-ordinator addresses in a supportive and very practical way the complexities associated with the rehabilitation of patients with chronic renal disease and those with end stage renal disease. A pivotal aspect of the role involves assessing the level of family support and providing information and advice regarding treatment options. There are many choices to be made in respect of renal replacement therapy i.e. career, family, finances, possible housing improvements or relocation, provision of suitable dialysis times and transport. When patients change from one modality of renal replacement therapy to another the Patient Care Co-ordinator provides the necessary support to facilitate this transition. The Patient Care Co-Ordinators are assigned and accountable for a caseload of patients. They work in close collaboration with each other with regard to addressing difficult problems associated with individual patients/families. They are expected to be fully aware of the needs of individual patients and provide support and cover for one another, as required. The Patient Care Co-ordinator aims to keep the patient on renal replacement therapy living as independently as possible in his/her own home environment. To achieve this objective he/she liaises closely with family members to encourage their continued support and organises appropriate community support services. The Patient Care Co-ordinator identifies and supports patients who will require interim placement while rehabilitating or long term care placement and liaises with the hospital services and appropriate external agencies to arrange home supports or short - long term placement. Responsibilities: **OBJECTIVES OF THE POST:** 1. To administer the co-ordination of Beaumont Hospital Renal Replacement Programmes and to co-ordinate this activity with relevant Renal Units and satellite units throughout the country. 2. To identify and address particular problems/needs that arise with individual patients/families as a result of a diagnosis of chronic renal disease and takes appropriate action to resolve or improve these difficulties. 3. He/she actively develops communication systems with renal units and satellite units, other agencies (statutory and voluntary) and Renal Units to ensure that the co-ordination of patient care is effectively and efficiently carried out in the best interest of the patient. 4. To assist in the audit of workflow between Beaumont Hospital Dialysis Services and other Dialysis Units throughout the country. 5. To ensure the patient journey is seamless and that every patient has a plan of care 6. Active member of the weekly Low Clearance Clinic MDT to ensure patients have all the necessary information to make an informed choice regarding preferred treatment option. 7. Organising MDT with consultants and relevant treatment CNMs to discuss patients preferred choice of treatment. **DETAILS OF RESPONSIBILITIES:** 1. Provides ongoing support, specialist advice and education to patients and their families through the entire process of care with regard to:- * The nature and effect of the patient's health problem. * The patients modality of replacement therapy i.e. Haemodialysis, Peritoneal Dialysis, conservative management or Renal Transplantation * General health promotion * Provides information on support services available to both patients and family 2. Assessment of new patients referred for renal replacement therapy and assess the level of family support. The assessment process involves meeting the patient over a number of days prior to the formulation of a meaningful report. During this period the Patient Care Co-ordinator should encourage relationships between the patient, family and the multi-disciplinary team and provide appropriate information and advice regarding treatment options. The information pertinent to future care plans for the patient should include:- * Demographic history of immediate family and siblings. * Appropriate data in relation to personal and family circumstances/support network. * Description of housing accommodation and facilities. * Availability of telephone and transport to facilitate communication and travel. * Health insurance. * Identify specific problems/needs of patients, which require improvement or resolution. * The patient’s and family’s view regarding the preferred form of Renal Replacement Therapy. Compile a confidential report on the interview findings which should be concluded with the Patient Care Co-ordinator’s assessment of the patient’s ability to adjust to Renal Replacement Therapy and to partake in his/her treatment plan. The report is made available to, and discussed with, the relevant Consultant Nephrologist and Nursing Staff. These reports are securely filed in the patient’s medical chart In consultation with the multi-disciplinary team formulate and implement plans to establish the patient on his/her chosen modality of treatment. All treatment options must be discussed with the patients and family and the chosen option discussed with the medical and nursing team in that area. Encourage patients to remain in employment and assist them to seek education, training and employment opportunities. Encourage patients to maintain social activities and personal hobbies. Assists patients and relatives where necessary in making applications for statutory entitlements and provide supporting letters. Monitor risk factors in the vulnerable and older patient groups such as social isolation and insecurity; make referrals to day care centres and other local activities, as appropriate, on behalf of individual patients. Advise individual patients as appropriate. 3. I. With regard to regular Haemodialysis:- Ensure patient is referred to the renal vascular coordinator as required Secure a suitable regular haemodialysis “slot” with due regard for the patient’s catchment area employment/child rearing commitments and availability Liase closely with external HD Units to ensure timely transfer of patients to their catchment area dialysis unit or to Beaumont eg. transition from Childrens hospital to Beaumont Arrange transport with the transport services within Beaumont and nationally and ensure the most cost effective methods is utilised. Monitor changing circumstances and practical needs of patients on renal replacement therapy and take necessary action to solve emerging problems. II. With regard to peritoneal dialysis (CAPD/CCPD) & Home Haemodialysis In consultation with the home therapies team ensures that patients have adequate facilitates to safely carry out treatment in their home environment. Liase with local authority agencies and Health Boards regarding applications for home modifications and grant entitlements. Make applications to relevant Health Boards on behalf of new patients commencing CAPD/CCPD/Home Dialysis for the supply of dialysis equipment and solutions. Monitor changing circumstances and practical needs of patients on renal replacement therapy and take necessary action to solve emerging problems. III. With regard to Conservative management – Coordinate with Ambulatory care, Nurse counsellor and medical team to support the patient and family on this treatment option Assist with sensitive discussions regarding advanced care planning. Liaise with palliative care services where necessary IV. With regard to Kidney Transplantation – Along with the MDT support the patient in their approach to renal transplantation. 4. Works in collaboration with the Multi-disciplinary team with regard to identifying discharge problems and co-ordinates and implements arrangements for post discharge care in consultation with the community care services. I. Co-ordinate discharge planning and liase closely with Community Support Services. II. Arranges and documents multidisciplinary team meetings with patients and families, in a timely manner when necessary. III. Liaises with the patient flow department in Beaumont re issues on discharging patients home IV. Liaises closely with Public Health Nurses with regard to the provision of community nursing care services. V. Arranges step down convalescent care for patients who would benefit from this service. VI. Collaborate with consultants and associated health care team members both in the hospital and community to ensure that patients are discharged in a timely, efficient and effective manner. VII. Complete SAT assessment for patients in Beaumont Hospital and relevant off-site facilities, who require Long-Term Care. VIII. Liase and manage Home Care Packages, Home Help Assessment and Beaumont Hospital in the home referrals. The person holding this post is required to support the principle that the care of the patient comes first at all times and will approach their work with the flexibility and enthusiasm necessary to make this principle a reality for every patient to the greatest possible degree Support key staff to promote appropriate discharge plans which are decided and implemented within Beaumont Hospital and relevant off-site facilities in a timely and appropriate manner. of research activities in the MPCE Department and in other departments to which services are provided. * Contribute as required to the development of in-house and external training programmes. * Participate in in-service training courses and conferences to a level that will ensure their competence and knowledge is kept up to date. * Manage the Department’s 24 hour on-call service. * Contribute to the preparation of budgetary estimates for the Department’s expenditure. * Perform such other duties as may be assigned to you by the Head of Department. * Participate and co-operate with legislative and regulatory requirements in relation to Health and Safety as outlined in the Safety, Health and Welfare Act 2005 and the Hospital Safety Statement and medical device regulations. * title: Java Software Engineer Intern
description: **Job Description** Are you ready to turn your passion for technology into real-world impact? General Motors is seeking a motivated and curious **Java Software Engineer Intern** to join our innovative engineering team. At GM, we are working toward a future with zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion. As an intern, you’ll gain hands-on experience developing software that supports the future of mobility while learning from experienced engineers in a collaborative, high-performance environment. This opportunity is designed for students who are excited to build their technical skills, solve meaningful problems, and see how modern software engineering helps transform the automotive industry. **About General Motors** General Motors is a global company driven by engineering, technology, and design. Our teams are developing connected, intelligent, and increasingly autonomous vehicles and services that improve the way people move around the world. As part of GM, you’ll work alongside talented professionals who are passionate about innovation, customer impact, and building technology that makes a difference. **Your Opportunity** As a **Java Software Engineer Intern** , you’ll contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of software applications and services. You’ll work with engineering teams to translate requirements into reliable, scalable solutions and gain exposure to the complete software development lifecycle. You may contribute to applications supporting connected vehicles, cloud platforms, enterprise services, data processing, or other technology initiatives across GM. **What You’ll Do** * Develop and enhance software applications using Java and object-oriented programming principles. * Collaborate with software engineers, architects, product managers, and business partners to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions. * Design, implement, and test RESTful APIs and backend services. * Write clean, readable, maintainable, and well-documented code. * Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve software quality. * Troubleshoot defects, investigate technical issues, and contribute to root-cause analysis. * Create unit and integration tests to validate application functionality and reliability. * Work with databases, data models, and SQL queries as part of application development. * Use Git and modern CI/CD practices to support efficient software delivery. * Contribute to Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, and sprint planning. * Learn and apply secure software development and DevSecOps practices. * Document technical decisions, solutions, and implementation details. * Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes and reduce manual effort. **What You’ll Bring** * Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. * Experience programming in Java through coursework, projects, internships, or personal development. * Understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and software design fundamentals. * Familiarity with relational databases and basic SQL. * Knowledge of software development practices, debugging, and testing. * Familiarity with Git or another version-control system. * Interest in developing backend services, APIs, cloud applications, or enterprise software. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to break complex problems into manageable steps. * Ability to learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and take ownership of assigned work. * Collaborative approach and strong written and verbal communication skills. Why Join GM? This internship is more than an opportunity to write code. It’s a chance to build your professional network, learn from experienced engineers, contribute to meaningful projects, and discover how your skills can help shape the future of transportation. Your journey starts here. Join General Motors and help create the technology that will move the world forward. Hybrid This role is categorized as hybrid. The successful candidate is expected to report to the assigned GM office three times per week, at minimum, or as dictated by business needs. **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. **Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities** General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers. We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit **How we Hire** . **Accommodations** General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, **email** us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Junior Quantity Surveyor
description: **Junior Quantity Surveyor (Maynooth)** A leading civil engineering company is seeking a motivated **Junior Quantity Surveyor** to join their team on a **major road infrastructure project in Maynooth** . This is an excellent opportunity for a Quantity Surveyor with **at least 1 year of civil engineering experience** , ideally working on roads or large-scale civil infrastructure projects, to further develop their career in a dynamic and supportive environment. **Key Responsibilities:** * Assist in the preparation and submission of interim valuations, variations, and final accounts * Monitor project costs, budgets, and cash flow forecasts under the guidance of senior QS staff * Support procurement processes for subcontractors and preparation of subcontract agreements * Conduct site visits to verify progress and assist with valuations * Liaise with site teams, project managers, subcontractors, and clients * Assist in identifying and managing commercial risks and opportunities * Ensure all commercial activities are carried out in line with company procedures **Requirements:** * Minimum 1 year experience as a Quantity Surveyor on civil engineering projects, preferably road or large-scale infrastructure * Knowledge of cost management and contract administration within civil projects * Ability to work on-site and collaboratively within a project team * Strong communication, analytical, and organisational skills * Relevant degree qualification in Quantity Surveying or related discipline **Benefits:** * Competitive salary of **€45,000 – €50,000 per annum** (depending on experience) * Pension scheme * Exposure to large-scale road infrastructure projects * Career development and progression opportunities within a leading civil engineering company If you are a motivated **Junior Quantity Surveyor** looking to gain valuable on-site experience on a major road infrastructure project in Maynooth, please send your CV or contact **a.maguire@gpcireland.com** for more information.

title: Keyholder
description: **Company Description** Hackett London, founded in 1983 by Jeremy Hackett, is a global menswear brand renowned for blending classic British style with modern sophistication. The brand offers collections ranging from sports and casual wear to tailored formal attire, all reflecting a strong commitment to quality and refined design. Key lines include Hackett Sport and Hackett Heritage, which draw on British sporting traditions, as well as a Savile Row collection and bespoke service crafted from premium fabrics. With over 1,000 points of sale worldwide, Hackett serves a diverse, international clientele seeking versatile clothing that transitions seamlessly from work to social occasions. The company continues to evolve, combining heritage with contemporary elegance to define modern menswear for customers around the globe. **Role Description** The Keyholder role at Hackett London in Kildare is a full-time, on-site position supporting the store’s daily operations and customer experience. Responsibilities include opening and closing the store, ensuring security procedures are followed, and maintaining store presentation and merchandising standards. The Keyholder assists in driving sales by providing attentive, tailored customer service, sharing detailed product knowledge, and supporting the team in achieving sales targets. This role also involves handling transactions, managing customer inquiries and feedback, and helping coordinate stock replenishment and visual displays. The Keyholder acts as a role model on the shop floor, supporting the management team and contributing to a positive, professional, and inclusive work environment. **Qualifications** * Candidates should possess strong Customer Service and Customer Experience skills to deliver personalized, high-quality support and build lasting relationships. * Candidates should possess solid Retail Sales and Communication skills to engage confidently with customers, handle transactions, and support sales goals. * Candidates should possess thorough Product Knowledge skills to accurately present features, fits, and styling options and represent the Hackett brand standard. * Previous experience in premium or luxury retail, fashion, or apparel environments is beneficial. * Ability to take responsibility for store keys, follow security procedures, and support opening and closing routines. * Strong teamwork and reliability, with flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and varied shifts as needed. * Proficiency in basic POS systems and cash handling; additional languages are an advantage.

With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. title: NPI Engineer
description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **About The Team** The Voyager team is an elite engineering and design division specializing in cutting-edge computing and communication solutions at the network edge. We integrate enterprise networking capabilities with robust hardware and software platforms built to thrive in the most demanding environments. The company is scaling rapidly, and we are looking for an NPI Engineer who is excited to solve complex scaling challenges and build the future of defense hardware. The Mission As an NPI Engineer, you will be the vital technical bridge connecting our Product Development (R&D) team, the Production Department, and our external contract manufacturers. We don't just build things on a lab bench; we scale them for the real world. Your mission is to take ambiguity, incomplete designs, and early prototypes from R&D and translate them into solid, high-yield, and repeatable builds that can be seamlessly scaled in production. You will work with cutting-edge technology—including next-generation processors that haven't even been released to the wider market yet—and play a key role in delivering high-stakes hardware programs What You Will Do * Bridge the Gap: Act as the technical anchor between R&D, test engineering, production, contract manufacturers, finance, and legal. * Manage Product Data: Create and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs) and drive the Engineering Release and Engineering Change Order (ECO) processes using our PLM systems. * Lead Scale Up & Validation: Design and execute product and process validations to prove that a design built once on a desk can be successfully built by the hundreds on the production floor. * Active Project Ownership: Partner with experienced engineering mentors to run prototyping, initial engineering builds, and design verification. You will start with more straightforward products (like radio brackets and accessories) to master our systems, eventually taking full, autonomous ownership of major product lines. * Collaborate in Agile Environments: Attend product development SCRUMs and cross-functional meetings, keeping all stakeholders aligned on schedule, quality, and technical requirements. * Optimize Manufacturing: Analyze existing products and processes for failure analysis, identifying opportunities for design-for-manufacturability (DFMA) and continuous improvement. **Who You Are (Required Qualifications)** * Education: Degree in Electronic, Mechatronic, or Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent). * Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in the electronics industry, specifically working with printed circuit boards (PCBs/PCBAs), cables, fan assemblies, and complex electromechanical integrations. * Systems Savvy: Proven experience managing data within PLM systems such as PTC Windchill or Teamcentre. Experience working with MRP systems (like Oracle or SAP Business One) is highly desired. * Standards & Validation: Solid working experience in an ISO9001 certified environment, with a strong grasp of product and process validation methodologies. * The "T-Shaped" Engineer: You possess a broad understanding of multiple business domains (from hardware engineering to supply chain and finance) alongside deep technical competence in electronics manufacturing. * Assertive Communicator: You are articulate and have the confidence to "stand your ground." You can collaborate with brilliant R&D designers, but you aren’t afraid to professionally push back when a design is not optimized for assembly. **Benefits** The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information, Explore Our Benefits.* **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind * No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * Please always verify communications: + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
